hardware.worker_admission: profile complete workloads and unified memory pressure; CPU maximum is not a concurrency requirement

reuse.source_states: reuse exact compatible completed fits; rebuild only affected source training/selection contracts
reuse.frozen_features: cache independent per-date Copernicus features only under identical preprocessing, weights and numerical identity
reuse.P0_P1: same trained states and event image; replace one pre-image; identical inputs may share predictions
reuse.identities: separate training, inference and scoring identities; changed evaluation metadata alone does not require source refitting
reuse.unet: train standard U-Net; frozen foundation-encoder cache is not a substitute for U-Net image training

scientific_invariants: source-only tuning, thresholds and reference-policy selection
three independent source-training seeds for learned pipelines
all eligible external records and assessable local radar cases
native-grid complete inference, validity and provenance preservation
same event image and trained weights for P0 and P1
no target label adaptation or target label-budget grid
no external-test score-based pipeline, image or event selection
numerics: float32 until a separately versioned and validated change; no unconditional mixed-precision or lossy-cache speedup
resume: verify optimizer, scheduler, RNG and data-order state for true training resume; best-weight-only checkpoints are not full resumable state
cost_accounting: report all source search/validation/refit, acquisition, QA, unique encoding, full inference, storage/recovery; distinguish one-off research from cold/warm new-area mapping
pending: external event and geographic overlap checks
runtime_estimate: pending scoped profiles and fit-reuse inventory; superseded broad-programme ETA does not apply

storage_strategy.source: reuse held source imagery and exact compatible feature cache
storage_strategy.target: compressed COGs plus tile/event streaming; do not materialize whole-cohort features
storage_strategy.probabilities: lossless per-seed outputs and required provenance; remote archival/readback with bounded local rotation
storage_strategy.envelope_status: profiling allowance, not measured peak or an immutable storage cap

inference_invariants: native1024px target grid covered by declared224px windows with valid edge handling
per-crop physical metadata and common policy support
reuse date encoding across source seeds without averaging incompatible models
do not multiply final external inference by source-CV folds implicitly
runtime_evidence: existing selected source-subset medians82min native/38min standard U-Net; external encoder-only linear projection~2.4h at25windows/tile; neither is complete-run ETA
